title: Luật Trật tự, an toàn giao thông đường bộ (văn bản hợp nhất)
notes: Replaces the standalone 36/2024/QH15, which Luật 118/2025/QH15 amended with effect from 2026-07-01: it removed the 10-hour daily driving limit and changed the child restraint rules. Two decrees already in this corpus state that 36/2024 was so amended, so carrying the unamended text meant answering with repealed rules. Text comes from the thuvienphapluat.vn Word edition (downloaded manually); the official PDF on datafiles.chinhphu.vn is the reference.
